breaking_news.headline: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq composite goes negative for the year
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market's direction. They were responsible for Wall Street's big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market.

breaking_news.headline: The AI boom had a really bad week — and it's raising loud alarms
breaking_news.summary: AI stocks — and the broader markets — got pummeled this week, raising major concerns about the financial system and the wider economy. Here's what to know.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic says it will put humanity first. Will its IPO change that?
breaking_news.summary: Critics say now that the AI giant is a public company, its commitment to put safety ahead of commercial success will be tested.

breaking_news.headline: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
breaking_news.summary: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

breaking_news.headline: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
breaking_news.summary: Older drivers are using Tesla's automated driving technology to stay on the road longer. But safety experts warn the company may be over-selling what its cars can do.

breaking_news.headline: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
breaking_news.summary: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Huang's return as a national security risk.

breaking_news.headline: Some women in tech have concerns about Huang's return
breaking_news.summary:
Women who have advocated for DEI in tech say Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA as CEO sends a message that in Silicon Valley, all that matters is money.

breaking_news.summary: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

breaking_news.summary: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

breaking_news.headline: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war

breaking_news.summary: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.
